title: runner: unify the triplicated workflow-existence check

raw.title: runner: unify the triplicated workflow-existence check
raw.body:
The predicate \`!locator.document.workflowIndex.has(locator.workflowId)\` + a \`workflow-not-found\` throw appears at three altitudes in \`WorkflowExecutor\` — \`#dependencyRefs\`, \`#runReferencedWorkflow\`, and \`#resolveWorkflow\` — with three differently-shaped errors. The duplication has already produced an observable inconsistency: a \`goto\`/\`retry\` reference to a missing workflow errors with the calling \`stepId\` attached, but a **sub-workflow step's** missing target lands on \`#resolveWorkflow\`'s generic error with no \`stepId\` — the position where caller context is most useful gets the poorest error.

Candidate fix: move existence into \`ArazzoWorkflowLocatorNormalizer.normalize\` (its context already carries \`workflowId\`/\`stepId\`, and the reference-as-written is available for the message), shrinking \`#resolveWorkflow\`'s check to the root-\`execute()\` path. Error attribution changes, so tests asserting \`workflowId\`/message shapes will need deliberate updates — which is why this was split out of PR #73 rather than folded in.

Part of the pre-1.0 cleanup train feeding the API surface review.
